name: com.sunblink.unity-remote-control.roslyn
description: Roslyn 4.9.2 compiler DLLs used by com.sunblink.unity-remote-control's exec command. Install this ONLY if your project does not already provide Roslyn (Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.*) — two copies cause duplicate-assembly errors. The server names no Roslyn assembly, so it compiles against whichever copy is present.
